title: Do I need to remove the handles before recycling a paper gift bag?
summary: In Calgary, leave paper handles attached and remove rope or ribbon handles before recycling a paper gift bag.

items.title: Do I need to remove the handles before recycling a paper gift bag?
items.summary: In Calgary, Canada, paper handles can stay on a paper gift bag when it goes in the blue recycling cart. Remove rope handles, ribbon, shoelaces and metal rivets. Those pieces go in the black garbage cart. You can also take the paper bag to a community recycling depot.
items.buyerNote: Look inside the bag where each handle meets the rim. If a cord runs through a metal ring, pulling out the cord still leaves the ring to remove. If you plan to give the bag to someone else, keep the handles in place for its next use. Outside Calgary, check the recycling rules for your address.
